summary: Keep internal data review, cleanup and correction, and the third-party models, libraries and vendors Kanopy uses, out of release notes.

api.assessment: Changes only release-note drafting instructions and impact-entry validation: published notice text may no longer describe internal data review, cleanup or correction, and no field of a new entry may name third-party models, libraries, vendors or their pricing. Application endpoints, authentication, permissions, processing outputs and storage policy are unchanged.

rollout: After merge into each repository's default branch together with the companion engine copies. Application deployment and package publication rules do not change.
data_effect: No existing job data or processing outputs change; no rerun is required. Already-published release wording and existing impact entries are not rewritten or re-checked.

developer_notice.reason: Internal release-authoring safeguard; no API or application behavior changes.
